english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something rigid or for muscles that feel tight and stiff.
Use this instead of 生硬 when the main point is stiff or awkward physical movement.

examples.english: My legs are still stiff after exercising.
examples.traditional: 我做完運動之後，對腳仲係僵硬。

examples.english: My legs got wooden from the cold.
